tagline.en_US: Share files through temporary download links and manage them from a web interface. Gokapi stores its configuration and application data in separate persistent directories and uses its built-in database.

description.en_US: Gokapi is a self-hosted file sharing platform designed for distributing temporary files securely. It allows registered users to upload files that automatically expire after a specified number of downloads or days. The platform supports end-to-end encryption, file deduplication, user role management, and file requests that let external users upload files directly.
